book.name: ROMANOS
book.title: Man Wuj Ri Xtak Pablo Riq'uilak Yak Aj Roma

content: Rajwaxi' tikajach kac'aslemal laj jk'ab' Kakaj Dios

Atak wech'elxic chirij Kakaj Jesucristo, in tamb'ijb'i chawechak jwi'l sub'laj tiel ranm Kakaj Dios chikij, rajwaxi' tajach ayb'ak laj jk'ab' Kakaj Dios pi jun tosol y yo'l sipan ri tisujsaj re Kakaj Dios ri tzi tril. Jilonli jnimirsaj jk'ij Kakaj Dios tab'antak.

Ma b'an awechak chapca' trantak mak cristian ri retake wich ulew, ye'tak luwar chi Kakaj Dios tijq'uex ano'jak pire tran aac' re ac'aslemalak, jilonli tawetemajtak lawi' raj Kakaj Dios tab'antak. Ri' b'antak lawi' ri tzi tril Kakaj Dios y ri kes pi jcholajl.

Jwi'l xye' rutzil ranm Kakaj Dios chwe wi' jcowil ínchi' tamb'ij chawechak atak juntir chi ma b'ijtak chi ajujunalak chi mas nim ak'ijak chapca' tachomorsajtak laj awanmak, ri' chomorsajtak nen ab'anicak chiwch Kakaj Dios chapca' jnimal jcub'arb' ach'olak ri ye'l chawechak jwi'l Kakaj Dios.
Chapca' katio'jl junke, pero wi' q'uilaj q'uer re y mak q'uer re katio'jl jalani' tichacuj chi jujunal.
Y jilon kab'anic oj ajtakeltak re Kakaj Jesucristo, sub'laj oj q'ui, pero ojke jun chi tio'jl kanuq'uemtak kib' jwi'l ojchak jun riq'ui Kakaj Jesucristo.

Kakaj Dios jaljoji' kacwinel ri sipal chike jwi'l chapca' nen mo raj re xye' chike jwi'l xye' rutzil ranm Kakaj Dios chike. Wi wi' jono sipal jcwinel pire jk'asaj Jyolj Kakaj Dios, rajwaxi' jk'asaj Jyolj Kakaj Dios chapca' jcub'arb' jch'ol chirij Kakaj Dios.
Wi wi' jono sipal jcwinel chi jt'o'ic cristian, rajwaxi' tit'o'onc. Y wi wi' jono sipal jcwinel chi jtijoj cristian, rajwaxi' titijonc.

Y wi wi' jono sipal jcwinel chi jye'ic jcowil ranmak cristian, rajwaxi' jye' jcowil ranmak cristian y wi wi' jono sipal jcwinel chi sipanc, rajwaxi' jye' mas. Y wi wi' jono sipal jcwinel pire jb'ab'al jun k'at cristian, rajwaxi' tzi rilic jcholajl tran chijxo'lak. Y wi wi' jono sipal jcwinel pire tran utzil re cristian jwi'l tiel ranm chirijak, rane' pi qui'cotemal.
Ri rajwax tran jun ajtakel re Kakaj Jesucristo
Kes tz'etel tz'et lok'aj ayb'ak chawib'il ayb'ak riq'ui nojel awanmak. Xuttak mak etzltak no'j y ri' b'antak tzitaklaj no'j.
Lok'aj ayb'ak chawib'il ayb'ak chapca' ak'un awatz ayb'ak y coj ak'ijak chawib'il ayb'ak riq'ui nojel awanmak.
Jach ayb'ak chi jb'anic lawi' raj Kakaj Dios tab'antak, ma sak'oraj ayb'ak. B'antak riq'ui nojel awanmak lawi' raj Kakaj Dios ri Kajawl tab'antak.
Qui'cotentak chirij ri jcub'arb' ach'olak ri wi'. Cuytak riq'ui nojel awanmak juntir c'ax ri tatijtak y ma quib'aj awanmak. Coc'xo'l ch'a'wentak riq'ui Kakaj Dios.
T'o'tak yak ajtakeltak re Kakaj Jesucristo ri wi' rajwax rechak. Ye'tak jposadak yak ri titawtak laj awichochak.
Tz'onajtak re Kakaj Dios chi tran utzil rechak yak ri tib'anowtak c'ax chawechak y ma tz'onajtak c'ax chib'ak.
Qui'cotentak riq'uilak yak ri tiqui'cottak y ok'entak riq'uilak yak ri tiok'tak.
Niq'uib'ok awchak atak juntir. Ma coj ak'ijak, rajwaxi' pachij ayb'ak pach yak ri ta' cojol jk'ijak y ma chomorsajtak laj awanmak chi mas ano'jak.
Ma q'uixelajtak jb'anic c'ax re nen tib'anow c'ax chawechak, ri' b'antak lawi' ri tzi chiwchak cristian.
B'antak utzil ri nen jnimal atcwintak chi jb'anic pire tiwa'x utzil chaxo'lak riq'uilak juntir cristian.

Atak lok'lajtak wech'elxic chirij Kakaj Jesucristo, ma b'antak jq'uixel mak c'ax ri tib'ansaj chawechak, jachtak laj jk'ab' Kakaj Dios, re wi' k'atb'itzij laj jk'ab' chi jb'anic k'atb'itzij chib' nen tib'anow c'ax chawechak, jwi'l tz'ib'ali' li wuj re Lok'laj Jyolj Kakaj Dios ri tijb'ij jilonri:

content.text: Wi' k'atb'itzij laj ink'b' chi jb'anic k'atb'itzij chib' nen tib'anow c'ax chawechak, tiche' Kakaj Dios.

content: Pero wi jun acontre tic'ok wi'jal, ye' jwa y wi tichekej jchi', ye' ruc'a'. Cuando tab'an jilonli, re tichak q'uixib' jwi'l juntir ri b'anal chawe jwi'l.
Ma ye' ayb' pire tich'econ mak etzltak no'j chab', ri' mas tzi at atch'econ chib' mak etzltak no'j jwi'l utzil ri tab'an.
